Interface MessageCodec

All Known Subinterfaces:
JsonMessageCodec
All Known Implementing Classes:
JsonMessageCodecImpl
public interface MessageCodec
Codec for serializing and deserializing Message objects to and from a string representation.

The concrete implementation determines the wire format (e.g. JSON). Used by the Socket transport to encode outbound Event records and decode inbound Command records.
